    def _get_nesting_depth(self, obj: Any, current_depth: int = 0) -> int:
        """Calculate maximum nesting depth of a dictionary."""
        if not isinstance(obj, dict):
            return current_depth
        
        if not obj:
            return current_depth
        
        max_depth = current_depth
        for value in obj.values():
            if isinstance(value, dict):
                depth = self._get_nesting_depth(value, current_depth + 1)
                max_depth = max(max_depth, depth)
            elif isinstance(value, list):
                for item in value:
                    if isinstance(item, dict):
                        depth = self._get_nesting_depth(item, current_depth + 1)
                        max_depth = max(max_depth, depth)
        
        return max_depth
